parameters.name: planning_horizon_size
parameters.description: Size of the finite planning horizon

parameters.name: fixed_preparation_cost
parameters.description: Fixed preparation completion cost for each device

parameters.name: unit_production_cost
parameters.description: Unit production cost of each product on each device

parameters.name: device_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum processing capacity of each device

parameters.name: product_demand
parameters.description: Required demand of each product over the planning horizon

variables.name: device_enabled
variables.description: Binary variable equal to 1 if device is enabled and 0 otherwise

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product produced on each device

variables.name: total_cost
variables.description: Total minimized cost of the plan

constraints.name: device_enabled_binary_domain
constraints.description: Each device-enabled decision variable is binary.

constraints.name: production_nonnegative_domain
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative for every device-product pair.

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: Define total cost as the sum of fixed enabling costs and variable production costs.

constraints.name: demand_satisfaction_constraint
constraints.description: Each product's total production across all devices must meet the required demand.

constraints.name: device_capacity_constraint
constraints.description: For each device, total production across all products cannot exceed its capacity.

constraints.name: production_enablement_link
constraints.description: Production on a device is only allowed when that device is enabled.

objectives.name: total_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total cost of the plan, including fixed device enabling costs and variable production costs, while meeting all product demand.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total cost of the plan, consisting of fixed device enabling costs and variable production costs, subject to demand satisfaction and device capacity limits.
